```{r setup, cache=TRUE}
library(tidyverse)
source("R/main.R")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
    out.width = "100%", # enough room to breath
    out.height = "100%",
    fig.width = 9,
    fig.height = 5, # reasonable size
    fig.asp = 0.618,   # golden ratio
    fig.align = "center" # mostly what I want
)
```

# Dashboard {orientation="columns"}
## Indicateurs {width="30%"}
```{r don}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Don de bidoux"
list(
  icon = "coin",
  color = "primary",
  value = paste0(n, "$")
)
```

```{r nombre}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Nombre total de sortie"
list(
  icon = "check2-circle",
  color = "info",
  value = n
)
```

```{r km1}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Nombre total de kilomètre"
list(
  icon = "signpost-split",
  color = "success",
  value = paste(round(km_sum, 1), "km")
)
```

```{r elevation1}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Nombre total d'élévation"
list(
  icon = "chevron-double-up",
  color = "success",
  value = paste(round(ele_sum, 1), "m")
)
```
